item.title: Implement the specified token bucket and keyed limiter
item.brief: Implement the complete behavior in SPEC.md in ratelimit.py. Preserve the public APIs and default clock. Match all specified validation errors, full initial capacity, fractional refill with capacity cap, non-consuming wait_time, and backwards-clock handling. Implement independent per-hashable-key buckets, LRU eviction on both try_acquire and wait_time, full reset after eviction, max_keys validation, and accurate __len__. Keep the module dependency-free (standard library only). Check the implementation against the spec and existing tests, add focused tests for uncovered specified edge cases where useful, and commit the completed work. Acceptance: all specification cases are implemented, the existing tests pass, and the changes are committed on the assigned local branch.
